claim_boundary: The promoted classifications are the compact vacuum-cylinder sector split, the homogeneous neutral two-scalar clock sector, and the smooth fixed-coupling linearized positive-Berger sector on their separately declared phase spaces. On the exact positive Berger background, the lapse constraint and compact spatial averaging force delta Q_R=0 for every allowed fixed-coupling linearized tangent; with Omega_total(delta,L_D)=omega delta Q_R this gives the scoped verdict D_GAUGE. The selected gauge fermion is now applied by an exact finite-order BV-canonical shear, yielding a complete support-local cyclic gauge-fixed 54-row unary complex and contraction onto the retained 26 rows. Nonlinear q2, local D-equivariance, general nonlinear Koszul-Tate, total causal, boundary, and quantum verdicts remain open.
